title: Inauguration of New DDU-GKY Training Batch
excerpt: We successfully inaugurated our new batch of candidates under the DDU-GKY scheme, welcoming over 100 students eager to build their careers.
content:
Ruchitha Associates is proud to announce the successful inauguration of our new training batch under the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY). The event took place at our main training center and saw the participation of over 100 enthusiastic candidates from various rural areas.

Our Founder, Mr. Ravi Kumar Yelagapuri, addressed the students, motivating them to make the best use of this opportunity. The training will span over 3 to 6 months depending on the chosen trade, followed by rigorous placement drives.
